svg.title: photon-exercise
svg.desc: Use λ in meters, h=6.62607015×10⁻³⁴ J s and c=299792458 m/s, then divide joules by 1.602176634×10⁻¹⁹ J/eV. Approximate color is an aid, not calibrated colorimetry. The check accepts relative error ≤1%; this is a classroom scoring tolerance, not a physical uncertainty. Sources: https://physics.nist.gov/cuu/Constants/Table/allascii.txt

svg.title: Visible spectrum and selected wavelength
svg.desc: Approximate screen colors from 380 to 780 nm; selected wavelength is positioned on a linear wavelength axis.
